temporal_split.rule: chronological; holdout is the most recent season, never random
temporal_split.calibration_rule: latest pre-holdout season, disjoint from core training rows

in_artifact_calibrator_note: No 'calibrator' key is written by this training path. PredictionEngine applies a FittedCalibrator only when the artifact carries one, so live predictions apply no post-hoc calibration. The TemperatureScaledMetaModel wrapper sits on the stacking head, which the request path (_ensemble_predict_dict, an equal-weight base-learner average) does not execute.
